info.name: Sockless Mail
info.summary: Companion to Sockless Mail: a short web address and an installable browser app with an unread count
info.description:
**Optional companion to the Sockless Mail External App** (app id `sockless_mail`). Install Sockless Mail first; this app adds nothing on its own.
- **A short address**: the mail page opens at `/apps/socklessmail/` instead of AppAPI's `/apps/app_api/embedded/sockless_mail/sockless_mail`, and the Sockless Mail entry of the app menu points there. AppAPI's address keeps working. - **An installable browser app**: from that address the browser can install Sockless Mail as an app, named and pictured like it, which shows the unread count on its icon.
Everything else, including the mail page itself, still comes from the External App.
info.author: Jimmy Everling
